title: Current events
html:
Dungeon maps updated

New Dungeon maps have been posted for all dungeons up to Shadow's Embrace,along with quick reference outline tables.--Catwalksbyhimself 06:44, 7 May 2008 (CEST)

All dungeons up to Shadow's Embrace now have horizontal schematic maps and compact outline tables so that information will print on one page on most printers.--Catwalksbyhimself 03:34, 20 June 2008 (CEST)

Builds page updated

The Builds page has been revised for easier reading.--Catwalksbyhimself 06:44, 7 May 2008 (CEST)

Outposts

The Outpost pages are being updated with new maps.--Catwalksbyhimself 06:44, 7 May 2008 (CEST)
